categories.main_business_segments: IDEX operates through three primary business segments: Fluid & Metering Technologies (FMT), Health & Science Technologies (HST), and Fire & Safety/Diversified Products (FSDP). Each segment comprises multiple reporting units focused on specialized products and end markets, such as pumps, water metering, scientific fluidics, optics, sealing solutions, pneumatic technologies, fire and safety equipment, dispensing systems, and industrial banding products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: IDEX's core technologies include positive displacement pumps, precision fluidics, optical components, microfluidics, technical ceramics, pneumatic compressors, and engineered banding and clamping systems. Manufacturing methods emphasize high-precision engineering, custom solutions, and advanced materials processing, with a focus on quality, reliability, and meeting stringent customer specifications. The company leverages both in-house manufacturing and a global supply chain for parts and components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: IDEX serves a diverse set of customers across niche and mission-critical markets, including industrial, water and wastewater, energy, chemical, agriculture, semiconductor, food and pharmaceutical, life sciences, analytical instruments, fire suppression, rescue, automotive, aerospace/defense, and paint dispensing. The customer base is highly fragmented, with no single customer accounting for more than 3% of net sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: IDEX has a global footprint, with approximately 50% of sales generated in the U.S. and 50% internationally. The company operates manufacturing facilities in over 20 countries, with significant operations in Germany, India, the Netherlands, the UK, Italy, Switzerland, Canada, and China. Sales are well-diversified across North America, Europe, Asia, and other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: IDEX primarily operates as an original equipment manufacturer (OEM) and component supplier, positioned downstream in the supply chain by delivering finished products, subsystems, and engineered solutions directly to end customers or OEMs. The company also manufactures many of its own parts and components, integrating upstream activities where necessary.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: IDEX's strategic priorities center on organic growth, innovation, and targeted acquisitions to expand its technology portfolio and market reach. The company invests in R&D to develop new products and enhance existing offerings, with a focus on applied solutions for high-growth markets such as life sciences, water infrastructure, semiconductors, and fire safety. Recent acquisitions, such as Mott Corporation, reflect a focus on advanced materials and filtration technologies.
categories.revenue_model: IDEX generates revenue primarily through the sale of engineered products, components, and systems, as well as related services such as installation, maintenance, and software solutions. Revenue is recognized at the point of sale or over time for certain contracts, with a small portion derived from recurring service and support agreements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: IDEX competes with large diversified industrials and specialized technology companies, including Dover Corporation, Ingersoll Rand, Parker Hannifin, Danaher, Graco, and others, depending on the segment. The company positions itself as a leader in niche, high-value markets, emphasizing product quality, engineering expertise, and customer-centric solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For 2024, IDEX reported net sales of $3.27 billion, with flat overall growth and a 2% organic decline compared to the prior year. Adjusted EBITDA was $874 million (26.7% margin), and net income attributable to IDEX was $505 million. The company maintains strong cash flow, a robust balance sheet, and continues to pursue growth through acquisitions and operational excellence.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: IDEX differentiates itself through its focus on mission-critical, highly engineered solutions tailored to customer needs in specialized markets. The company emphasizes reliability, innovation, and quality, leveraging deep technical expertise and a decentralized operating model to deliver superior value and trusted performance. Its ability to integrate acquisitions and drive operational improvements further enhances its competitive advantage.
